plan.name: Free
plan.credits: monthly_limit per account (com 100, notcom 50, an account signed up 2026-10-22 300); total_credits_left is what remains
plan.rate_limit: at most available_credits at once (50; 200 on a new account), refilled by 20 every 600 s
plan.downloads: a file needs one download unlock per song (additional_download_remaining: com 7, notcom 7 when found, 0 on a new account; Earn Credits gives none); downloading an unlocked song again, in any format, is free

previews: a free generation may come back with two more clips on v6 (chirp-hawk, metadata.type preview, can_remix false): Suno's upsell, no extra credits; a file of one spends an unlock like any song, so takes save the v6-mini songs first and the previews stay in the library (2026-10-23, notcom)

speed.steps: semitones: 2^(n/12), n -24..24; an asked speed snaps to the nearest
